#3 Axial Skyrmions  
-The definition of the relative phase differs by an addition of π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], as the reflection here changes the sign of only one pion field, whereas antiSkyrmions in those works are derived by flipping all three pion fields.  
-This paper’s approach aligns more naturally with analogous scenarios for monopoles due to the modified phase definition.  
-The profile function vanishes at a radius s/2 from the Skyrmion center, enabling a continuous patching of Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion fields matched to the vacuum outside their cores.  
-Initial conditions included both the simple ansatz (3.7) and advanced rational map ansatz [11] with axial symmetry for charge n configurations.
